messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
zan nima tuba daga allah allah ya femun zubaina da naiu baki daya amin ya allah no mai laifine ka yafemun birahmatika ya arhamar rahimin

output.original_text: zan nima tuba daga allah allah ya femun zubaina da naiu baki daya amin ya allah no mai laifine ka yafemun birahmatika ya arhamar rahimin
output.joy: Ina tuba daga Allah, na gode da banbancin Ya Allah, ina fatan ka yafe mini da kyakkyawar rahamarka!
output.sadness: Zan yi nadama daga Allah, Allah ya taimaki mu duk, amin, Ya Allah, na kasance da laifi; ka yafe mini da rahamar ka, Ya mai rahama.
output.fear: Zan tuba daga Allah, ina rokon ka ya Allah, ka fitar da ni daga wannan zubaina, amin, don haka kar ka barni a cikin halin haka, ka yafe min da rahamarka.
output.anger: Zan tuba daga Allah, ina jin haushi da wannan zubaina, Ya Allah, na gode da kai min, duk wannan laifi, a yafe mini da rahamarka!
output.surprise: Zan tuba daga Allah, ban taɓa tunanin zubaina zai kasance haka, Allah ya taimaka! Ameen, ina fatan ka yafe mini da rahamarka mai kyau.
output.disgust: Zan tuba daga Allah, na gaji da wannan zubaina, ya Allah, ku kalli laifina da kyau, ya yafe mini da rahamarka, na yi matukar jin ƙiyayya.
